subject: Mobile Development
subcategory: Famous Apps That Changed the World
title: Slack: Killing Work Email
description: Learn Slack: Killing Work Email in one minute.

hook.text: A failed video game company pivoted its internal chat tool into a billion-dollar business.

buildup.text: Slack organized work conversations into channels, replacing endless email chains.

discovery.text: Slack grew from zero to a million daily users in just eight months after launch.

twist.text: Salesforce bought Slack for $27.7 billion — more than most countries' annual tech budgets.

climax.text: Slack proved that reimagining a boring tool like work chat could build an empire.

punchline.text: A failed game became a $27 billion chat app.

quiz.question: What was Slack originally?
options: An internal tool for a video game company
